game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway, a vine-choked archway: the rune scholar must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Index Archery: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway: a vine-choked archway
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Declare double: declare resource as double, apply resource * 4.5, and print each result with %.1f. Dataset 2 starts with [-3, 0, 10, 13]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Index Archery' (Week 7 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Overgrown Archway'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Reach the rune gate using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The rune gate reached with actions_used <= 22.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the rune gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Declare before use. double resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %.1f.
